title: Admissible subalgebra for the Popescu construction
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $B$ a commutative $k$-algebra, and $\mathfrak m\subset B$ an ideal. A $k$-subalgebra $A\subset B$ is admissible relative to $\mathfrak m$ if it is an Artinian local ring, essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra], its inclusion $A\to B$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and $\mathfrak m_A B=\mathfrak m$. In the Popescu construction $B=\bar\Lambda$ and $\mathfrak m$ is its maximal ideal.
